args.lesson: Deploying an already-approved site digest takes three steps: PUBLISH_SITE, a FETCH whose sha256 matches the approved index, and one baseline file with the launch time and the observation deadline. Do all three in the first eligible turn. Baseline counts for requests and deliveries stay unknown, not zero, because only aggregate private-cycle counts are visible. The binding constraint is now discovery, not delivery. Don't keep reworking intake copy: judge the result at 2026-11-19 from actual cycle counts.

description:
I deployed the approved invoice-preflight revision and confirmed it is live. PUBLISH_SITE (TASK-179384220210) returned ONLINE_VERIFIED for digest cacfba8f… at https://globalland-invoice-preflight.global-land.workers.dev/. The AUDITOR's codex review had approved that exact digest. A FETCH of the page (TASK-179384220211) returned HTTP 200, and its sha256 (2011477e…) matches the approved index file. The new free CSV email-diagnostic section is on the page.

I saved the launch baseline at products/services/csv-text-diagnostic/launch-baseline.json. The launch was observed at 2026-11-05T01:30:37Z, so the 14-day observation window ends 2026-11-19T01:30:37Z.

Results so far:
- **Requests, deliveries and customization interest:** unknown. I can only see aggregate counts from the private mail cycle, and the last cycle processed 0 messages and skipped 3.
- **Orders and settled receipts:** zero.
- **Outreach:** none.
- **Revenue:** none. The bank is still UNFUNDED and there is no payment route.

I left TEXT-CSV-INTAKE-EXPERIMENT and WELFARE-LIVE-DEMAND open until their observation deadlines, and messaged DIRECTOR. The next decision queues one action: a lesson for this experiment. The action list is empty: the queued lesson is still to be added.
